digest.component_or_area: live Jira Cloud integration lane + search-index-lag hardening
propositions: STEP_JQL_SEARCH in bridge check-access flakes on live Jira Cloud due to fixed 6×5s retry budget being shorter than Lucene-index eventual-consistency lag
JQL search wait must be replaced with env-tunable exponential backoff (default 10 retries, 3s base, 30s cap) to reach ~195s worst-case budget
Live Cloud coordinator lifecycle must be exercised end-to-end via a bounded, self-cleaning module that drives create + binding + commit-unknown-recovery + fuse against exactly one throwaway issue
The jira-cloud-mutation-probe workflow lane must export REBAR_PROBE_RUN_LABEL, run check-access + lifecycle module, and always-teardown by sweeping issues carrying that label via acli
Unit tests must validate the new JQL backoff schedule and env-override recomputation, and the workflow lane structure and label-scoped cleanup
